name: BPROP
recent: Berjaya Property 于2026年10月26日与 Citaglobal Berhad 签署有条件股份买卖协议，以 RM50 million 收购 Manjaran Sdn Bhd 20% 股权，完成后持股将增至49%。公司已向 Bursa Securities 申请上市及报价 178,571,429 股新股以支付部分收购代价，并于11月16日补充披露相关资讯。公司将于2026年12月9日召开第36届常年股东大会。
notable: 与 Citaglobal Berhad 签署有条件协议，以 RM50 million 收购 Manjaran Sdn Bhd 20% 股权，完成后持股增至49%。
就收购事项向 Bursa Securities 申请上市及报价 178,571,429 股新股。
将于2026年12月9日召开第36届常年股东大会。
risks: 拟发行 178,571,429 股新股作为收购代价的一部分，尚待 Bursa Securities 批准。
董事及主要管理层在闭市期内有买卖公司证券的意向。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为 RM1,922.7 million，环比增长4.8%；净利润为 RM1.8 million，净利率0.1%，较上一季度的-3.7%转正。

recent_en: On 26 October 2026, Berjaya Property entered into a conditional share sale agreement with Citaglobal Berhad to acquire a 20% stake in Manjaran Sdn Bhd for RM50 million, raising its shareholding to 49% upon completion. The company has applied to Bursa Securities for the listing and quotation of 178,571,429 new shares as part of the acquisition consideration, with additional information disclosed on 16 November.
notable_en: Signed a conditional agreement with Citaglobal Berhad to acquire a 20% stake in Manjaran Sdn Bhd for RM50 million, raising its shareholding to 49% upon completion.
Applied to Bursa Securities for the listing and quotation of 178,571,429 new shares in relation to the acquisition.
risks_en: Proposed issuance of 178,571,429 new shares as part of the acquisition consideration is pending Bursa Securities approval.
Directors and key management have indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM1,922.7 million, up 4.8% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM1.8 million with a net margin of 0.1%, turning positive from -3.7% in the previous quarter.
